press.subject: Breaking news: Trump set to break ground on triumphal arch before final approval
The Morning: Build first, ask later

summary.text: Trump is set to break ground on a triumphal arch near Arlington before final approval, part of broader White House construction, with warnings that the work endangers DCA flight paths. On September 3 the story surfaced with four posts from a single member; on September 4 no member posted originally, though members added five retweets while NYT and Politico carried the coverage. @RepDonBeyer leads it alone, pressing that the Administration has not responded to safety warnings from him and others. The framing remains one member's process-and-safety objection rather than a caucus message, and with two days and one voice it is too thin to call a shift. Open: whether other members engage, whether the Administration answers, and whether groundbreaking proceeds.
